# SciFig

AI-assisted scientific illustrations, data charts and structured flowcharts.

## Public resources
- [Official platform](https://scifig.ai/)
- [Three synthetic teaching examples](https://github.com/lilingm963/SciFig-AI/tree/main/examples)
- [Media library](https://github.com/lilingm963/SciFig-AI/blob/main/docs/media-library.md)
- [Templates](https://github.com/scifig-ai/scientific-poster-and-presentation-templates)
- [Scientific Figure Skill](https://github.com/lilingm963/scifig-ai-scientific-figure-skill)

Review scientific content and sources. Editing/export varies by workflow. Media, templates and Skill have separate licenses. The Skill does not call a SciFig API. No blanket scientific-accuracy or journal-acceptance claim is made.
